title: Our daily routine
titleJp: {二人|ふたり}の{毎日|まいにち}

canDos.text: Tell your partner what time you get up, leave home and go to bed on weekdays, and ask about theirs.

check.instructions: Your partner (or the app) asks about your weekdays. Answer each question with a real time, then ask the same questions back.
check.material:
「{平日|へいじつ}は{何時|なんじ}に{起|お}きますか。」
「{何時|なんじ}にうちを{出|で}ますか。」
「{夜|よる}は{何時|なんじ}に{寝|ね}ますか。」
rubric: Answers each question with a clock time (しちじ, しちじはん, ろくじよんじゅうごふん)
Puts に after the time: しちじにおきます
Uses the right verb each time: おきます, でます, ねます
Asks at least one question back (…はなんじにねますか？)

canDos.text: Catch the times in a short message about someone's day: when they leave, arrive and get home.

check.instructions: Your partner leaves you a voice message about tomorrow. You can play it twice. Then answer the questions.
check.material: 「あ、{私|わたし}です。あしたは{早|はや}いです。{五時半|ごじはん}に{起|お}きます。{六時十五分|ろくじじゅうごふん}にうちを{出|で}ます。{夜|よる}は{七時|しちじ}ごろ{帰|かえ}ります。{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}、お{願|ねが}いします！」

questions.q: What time will your partner leave home?
What do they ask you to do?
options: Buy bread on the way home

canDos.text: Write your partner a short note about tomorrow: what time you'll leave, where you're going and when you'll be back.

check.instructions: Your partner left this note on the fridge. Write a short reply (2–3 sentences): what time you'll leave tomorrow, where you're going and when you'll be back.
check.material:
あしたは{何時|なんじ}にうちを{出|で}ますか？
どこに{行|い}きますか？
{何時|なんじ}ごろ{帰|かえ}りますか？
rubric: Gives a leaving time with 〜じにでます (or 〜じにうちをでます)
Says where they're going with 〜にいきます
Says when they'll be back with 〜じごろかえります
Uses polite ます forms throughout

canDos.text: Buy things at a shop counter or food stand, asking for one, two or three of something.

check.instructions: You're buying lunch for both of you at a small food stand in the station, where everything is behind the counter. Check the prices, then ask the clerk (the app) for three rice balls and two teas, and ask how much it comes to.
rubric: Names each item with を and a number: おにぎりをみっつ、おちゃをふたつ
Asks with ください or おねがいします
Uses the counting words ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ (not いち, に, さん)
Asks the total with いくらですか

task.goal: Compare your schedules for tomorrow and agree on a time to eat dinner together at home.
task.outcomeQuestion: What time are you eating dinner tomorrow, and who is buying what on the way home?
task.infoA: Schedule card A (tomorrow): you get up at 5:30 (ごじはんにおきます) and leave home at 6:30. You finish early and get home around 5:00 (ごじごろかえります). You must be in bed by 10:00 (じゅうじにねます). You'll cook dinner, but you need six eggs (たまごをむっつ) and three apples (りんごをみっつ): ask your partner to buy them.
task.infoB: Schedule card B (tomorrow): you get up at 8:00 (はちじにおきます) and leave home at 9:00. Work runs late: you leave the office at 7:30 (しちじはんにかいしゃをでます) and get home around 8:15. There's a supermarket by the station, so you can shop on the way home (かえりに). Find out when your partner goes to bed, and agree a dinner time.
task.twist: Swap cards. This time the late partner gets home at 9:00 (くじにかえります), so agree a new dinner time or move it to breakfast together (あさごはん), and change the shopping list (four apples, よっつ).

scripted.jp: あしたは{何時|なんじ}に{起|お}きますか。
scripted.en: What time are you getting up tomorrow?

scripted.jp: {八時|はちじ}に{起|お}きます。{九時|くじ}にうちを{出|で}ます。
scripted.en: I'm getting up at eight. I'm leaving home at nine.

scripted.jp: {私|わたし}は{五時半|ごじはん}に{起|お}きます。{六時半|ろくじはん}に{出|で}ます。
scripted.en: I'm getting up at five thirty. I'm leaving at six thirty.

scripted.jp: {早|はや}いですね！ {何時|なんじ}に{帰|かえ}りますか。
scripted.en: That's early! What time will you be home?

scripted.jp: {五時|ごじ}ごろ{帰|かえ}ります。
{私|わたし}は{七時半|しちじはん}に{会社|かいしゃ}を{出|で}ます。{八時十五分|はちじじゅうごふん}ごろ{帰|かえ}ります。
scripted.en: I'm leaving the office at seven thirty. I'll be home around eight fifteen.

scripted.jp: じゃあ、{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}、{八時半|はちじはん}はどうですか。
scripted.en: Then how about dinner at eight thirty?

scripted.jp: いいですね。でも、{何時|なんじ}に{寝|ね}ますか。
scripted.en: Sounds good. But what time are you going to bed?

scripted.jp: {十時|じゅうじ}に{寝|ね}ます。{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}ですよ。
じゃあ、{八時半|はちじはん}ですね。{帰|かえ}りにスーパーに{行|い}きます。
scripted.en: Eight thirty, then. I'll stop at the supermarket on the way home.

scripted.jp: ありがとう！ {卵|たまご}をむっつ、お{願|ねが}いします。それから、りんごもみっつ。
scripted.en: Thanks! Six eggs, please. And three apples, too.

scripted.jp: わかりました。{卵|たまご}むっつ、りんごみっつですね。
scripted.en: Got it. Six eggs and three apples.

capstone.title: A day in our life
capstone.brief: Act out one weekday from morning to night: getting up, breakfast, leaving for work, buying two or three things at a bakery on the way home, and dinner. Each of you says what you do and when, and asks about the other's day.
